blockers.impact: A canonical object can be serialized as its own predecessor/successor, creating an invalid identity graph while satisfying the final integrated schema.
blockers.inherited_authority: C1-028 forbids predecessor/successor self-loops unless explicitly allowed by relation type.
required_repair: Require predecessor and successor canonical refs to be distinct for ADD_SUCCESSOR_RELATION / PREDECESSOR_OF.
If JSON Schema cannot compare the two refs, add an explicit named semantic validator contract.
Add positive distinct-endpoint and negative self-loop adversarial vectors.
Materialize inherited C1-028 in the final integrated C1 regression surface.
blockers.title: Predecessor/successor self-loop invariant is not materialized in the integrated R5 contract

blockers.impact: The final integrated contract can accept a ContractRecord whose referenced InstrumentRecord is an equity, debt, fund, depositary receipt, or index rather than a derivative product.
blockers.inherited_authority: C1.01R1 DEC-031 / C1-063 require every ContractID to have exactly one parent DERIVATIVE_PRODUCT InstrumentID.
required_repair: Add a cross-record semantic validator that resolves parent_instrument_ref to the exact InstrumentRecord and requires instrument_kind=DERIVATIVE_PRODUCT.
Add one valid DERIVATIVE_PRODUCT control and negative non-derivative-parent vectors.
Do not import C11 persistence internals; the rule is C1 identity semantics.
blockers.title: ContractRecord does not enforce that its parent Instrument is DERIVATIVE_PRODUCT

blockers.impact: Two individually valid records can move the same canonical ContractID or ListingID to a different Instrument parent without any final integrated semantic validator rejecting the transition.
blockers.inherited_authority: C1.01R1 DEC-031 / C1-064 forbid Listing/Contract Instrument-parent reassignment; replacement must use explicit termination/successor semantics.
required_repair: Add a cross-version semantic validator: same ContractID cannot change parent_instrument_ref.
Add a cross-version semantic validator: same ListingID cannot change instrument_ref.
Require explicit termination/create/successor semantics when identity genuinely changes.
Add adversarial two-snapshot reparent vectors for both Listing and Contract.
blockers.title: Listing/Contract parent reassignment prohibition is represented only as error vocabulary, not an executable integrated invariant

hardenings.detail: The schema can serialize CURRENT graph results with reconstructability=PIT_SAFE when their load-bearing dependencies are PIT-safe. Preserve the already-passed rule that a CURRENT resolution anchor is not itself historical PIT evidence and historical consumers must use HISTORICAL reconstruction unless C4 proves equivalence.
hardenings.title: Clarify CURRENT result PIT_SAFE wording

hardenings.detail: C1.01R1 already classified temporal duplicate/uniqueness formalization as a hardening. C1 should state the semantic uniqueness rule at a C4-defined temporal state while leaving persistence/idempotent coalescing to C11.
hardenings.title: Make ContractVenueAdmission active-state uniqueness executable before final C1 freeze
